assessment: Registered view A on primary eligible 2019 onsets: abrupt 6h recall **0.22** (2/9), abrupt full-window **0.44**, incipient **0.4**, unmatched/wk **1.27**, union% **7.71**, dup24h=57, episodes=74. Secondary abrupt-only view B abrupt 6h **0.33** (not a joint-detection claim). View C abrupt 6h **0.33**. Post-fit-only abrupt 6h (onset ≥ earliest eligible notify): **0.25** (2/8). 0–6 h shortened-window null: observed 3/9, frac shifts≥obs=0.00. No strong latched-only signature under declared heuristics. **Candid:** burden looks manageable (low unmatched/wk / occupancy), but six-hour abrupt sensitivity on the broader year is **not** useful enough under the same provisional bar used on DEV (≥2/3). Do not treat low FP rate alone as success. Do not select a secondary view as the sole headline; registered view remains A.
